heading: Modifications; Amendments
memo_rationale: Remove exceptions tied to the deleted cascade and unilateral adjustments. Correcting an error or updating an estimate is not permission to reprice the transaction. Changes affecting a guarantor require separate assent.
memo_replacement: A change to the Purchase Price, Purchased Amount, Specified Percentage, purchased-receipts base, fees, or other substantive term requires a written amendment signed by Buyer and Merchant and any disclosure or renewed acceptance required by law. An amendment enlarging a Guarantor’s obligation also requires that Guarantor’s separate signed consent. Reconciliation and correction of an erroneous collection under Section 3 implement existing terms and are not amendments. An informational estimate update does not change the parties’ substantive obligations.
current_body: Except as expressly provided in Sections 3.3, 3.4 and 4.15, no modification, amendment, waiver, or consent of any provision of this Agreement shall be effective unless the same shall be in writing and signed by both parties.
my_note: Remove the exceptions tied to the deleted cascade. Correcting an error is not licence to reprice.

heading: Assignment
memo_rationale: Buyer may transfer the economic interest, but reconciliation, refunds, and complaints must remain usable after transfer. Delegation ordinarily does not by itself discharge the delegating party; say that expressly, require qualified recipients and a single collection contact.
memo_replacement: Buyer may assign its purchased interest to a person lawfully entitled to hold it, provided the assignee takes subject to this Agreement, Merchant’s defenses, reconciliation and refund rights, and all applicable law. Buyer shall give Merchant prior notice where practicable, and otherwise prompt notice, identifying the assignee, effective date, servicing contact, and any changed payment instructions. No transfer increases any amount or percentage or interrupts servicing rights. Buyer remains responsible for its prior acts and for delegated duties unless Merchant expressly agrees to a lawful novation. Partial assignments shall use a single servicing and collection interface and may not multiply Merchant’s costs. Merchant may assign in connection with a permitted business transfer under Section 5.18 with consent not unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed.
current_body: Buyer may assign, transfer, or sell its rights to receive the Purchased Amount or delegate its duties hereunder, either in whole or in part. Merchant may not assign this Agreement without Buyer’s prior written consent, which consent may be withheld in Buyer’s sole discretion.
my_note: The right principle: we may sell the economics, but reconciliation, refunds and complaints must survive the transfer with a single servicing contact. This is also the clause that most affects merchants in practice.

heading: Notices
memo_rationale: Certified-mail-only receipt rules conflict with reconciliation, urgent notices, and reasonable consent revocation. Establish functional contacts before signing; distinguish legal process from administrative communications.
memo_replacement: Operational notices may be sent to the email and postal contacts stated in Section 1 by email, acknowledged servicing-portal submission, recognized overnight carrier, or certified mail. A notice is effective on actual receipt; an email is deemed received on the next Workday after transmission if no delivery-failure message is received, unless the sender knows it was not received. Buyer shall maintain a functioning servicing email and portal or telephone contact and promptly notify Merchant of changes. Requests under Section 3 and communications-consent revocations may also use the reasonable methods specified there. A notice asserting default shall identify the facts and requested cure and be sent by email and an additional reasonable delivery method. Judicial process is governed exclusively by Section 10.1, and no contractual notice presumption substitutes for valid service of process.
current_body: All notices, requests, consents, demands, and other communications hereunder shall be delivered by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the respective parties at the addresses set forth in this Agreement (or at such other address as the party shall specify in writing) and shall become effective only upon receipt.
my_note: Certified-mail-only receipt rules conflict with the reconciliation timelines we are promising in §3. Separate administrative notice from judicial process.

heading: Waiver of Remedies
memo_rationale: A nonwaiver clause is routine. Make it reciprocal and subordinate cumulative remedies to the no-double-recovery and nonrecourse limits; this is a balanced drafting recommendation.
memo_replacement: A party’s delay or failure to exercise a right is not a waiver of that right, and a partial exercise does not preclude another lawful exercise. A waiver must be in writing by the party giving it. All remedies remain subject to Sections 6 and 9, applicable law, and the prohibition on duplicate recovery.
current_body: No failure on the part of Buyer to exercise, and no delay in exercising, any right under this Agreement shall operate as a waiver thereof, nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right under this Agreement preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right. The remedies provided hereunder are cumulative and not exclusive of any remedies provided by law or equity.
my_note: Routine. Make it reciprocal and subordinate cumulative remedies to the no-double-recovery limit.

heading: Survival of Representations
memo_rationale: Survival should preserve valid accrued claims without turning funding-date facts into perpetual warranties or keeping collection authority alive for every fee. Specify the post-completion duties that should survive.
memo_replacement: Representations speak only as provided in the representations lead-in. Completion does not extinguish a valid accrued claim within its lawful limitation period, but it ends future collection authority under Section 2.6. Reconciliation, refunds, final accounting, lien releases, lawful confidentiality and data-protection duties, and dispute-resolution provisions survive to the extent necessary to give them effect. No survival provision enlarges the nonrecourse obligation or Guaranty.
current_body: All representations, warranties, and covenants herein shall survive the execution and delivery of this Agreement and shall continue in full force until the Completion Threshold is attained and all amounts then due have been paid.
my_note: Survival should preserve accrued claims without making funding-date facts perpetual warranties.

heading: Entire Agreement
memo_rationale: The FRPA incorporates unseen instruments but supplies no reliable hierarchy. A broad merger clause can also be misused to erase required offer disclosures or misleading sales statements. Identify the actual signed package and retain statutory rights.
memo_replacement: This Agreement consists of its completed Section 1, these terms, the signed Guaranty if any, the identified signed exhibits, and any applicable state rider delivered before acceptance. No unseen or later-added document is incorporated. Mandatory law controls; an applicable state rider controls inconsistent general terms; the nonrecourse, collection-cap, reconciliation, and guaranty limits control inconsistent ancillary authorizations. Required disclosures shall be retained with the executed package and accurately reflect the agreed transaction; they are not waived by integration. Separate equipment, subscription, and ISO agreements do not create cross-default, collateral, fee, or guaranty obligations under this Agreement. Nothing excludes liability for fraud, unlawful misrepresentation, or breach of a legally binding offer or statutory disclosure duty.
current_body: This Agreement embodies the entire agreement between Merchant and Buyer and supersedes all prior agreements and understandings relating to the subject matter hereof.
my_note: The merger clause currently incorporates five unseen instruments with no hierarchy, and a broad merger clause can be misused to erase required offer disclosures. Name the actual signed package and preserve statutory rights.

heading: Return of Buyer Proceeds
memo_rationale: “Proceeds of the Purchased Amount” confuses a face amount with actual assets. An express trust label cannot create ownership of ungenerated receipts or bind nonparties. Limit accounting and remittance to the identified purchased share actually received, without a whole-account freeze.
memo_replacement: If Merchant receives identifiable Purchased Receipts that should have been remitted through the processor, Merchant shall record them separately and deliver that purchased share to Buyer within three Workdays after the funds become available, with a supporting settlement reference. This duty does not reach Merchant’s retained share, non-card receipts, funds never received, or receipts already credited to Buyer. Buyer shall avoid duplicate collection and credit each remittance promptly. The parties’ ownership, tracing, and any trust rights are determined by applicable law; no label creates a personal obligation to pay ungenerated future receipts or binds a nonsignatory.
current_body: In the event that Merchant, or any of Merchant’s respective directors, officers, employees, agents, subcontractors, or affiliates receives or comes into possession of any proceeds of the Purchased Amount, Merchant shall, or shall cause such other recipients to, immediately segregate and hold such proceeds in express trust for Buyer’s sole and exclusive benefit. Such proceeds shall be delivered to Buyer in full within three (3) business days of such receipt.
my_note: 'Proceeds of the Purchased Amount' confuses a face amount with an actual asset, and an express trust label cannot create ownership of receipts that do not exist yet. This is 006 wearing different words. Limit to the identified share actually received; no whole-account freeze.

heading: Electronic Signatures
memo_rationale: Electronic signatures and copies are generally appropriate. Preserve signer identity, capacity, document version, timing, consent/attribution evidence, required disclosure signatures, and a downloadable complete copy. This clause does not cure missing assent or satisfy every separate statutory delivery requirement. [A22]
current_body: Electronic signatures (including those executed via any commercially recognized electronic-signature platform) shall be deemed acceptable for all purposes and shall have the same force and effect as original ink signatures. Electronic copies of this Agreement shall be treated as originals for all purposes.
my_note: Retain. The operational controls in the memo's note are the real content: signer identity, capacity, document version, consent evidence, and a downloadable complete copy. Pacta should be able to evidence every one of those — worth confirming we actually can.

heading: Attorney Review
memo_rationale: The opportunity-for-counsel recital is appropriate if real. The blanket nonreliance assertion can contradict sales conduct and should not waive fraud or statutory disclosure claims. No signature should falsely attest that counsel was actually consulted.
memo_replacement: Merchant and each Guarantor have been given the complete transaction documents and a reasonable opportunity to review them, ask questions, and consult independent counsel before signing. Each may choose whether to consult counsel. No party represents that counsel was consulted unless that occurred. This acknowledgement does not waive fraud, misrepresentation, required disclosures, legally attributable statements, or any non-waivable right.
current_body: Each Merchant and Guarantor acknowledges that it has had an opportunity to review this Agreement and all addenda with counsel of its choosing before signing or has chosen not to avail itself of that opportunity. Each Merchant and Guarantor further acknowledges that it has not relied on any representation by Buyer or any third party that is not set forth in this Agreement.
my_note: Keep the opportunity-to-consult recital if it is true. Delete the blanket non-reliance assertion; it should not waive fraud or statutory disclosure claims and it contradicts our own sales conduct.

heading: State Law Riders
memo_rationale: This clause misstates Texas’s whole-contract consequence, overlooks Virginia venue, and relies on severing provisions that covered contracts may not contain. A rider must be selected before offer/execution. Insert the Texas complaint notice below conspicuously for covered Texas transactions; a separate disclosure cannot replace this contract notice. Not all listed states prescribe an immutable visual form or require APR. [A8–A14]
memo_replacement:
Buyer shall determine applicable recipient-state requirements before making a specific offer and shall provide the required disclosures, obtain required signatures, and attach the applicable state rider before execution. Buyer shall omit any provision that applicable law prohibits the contract from containing. No party waives a statutory right or represents that this general clause cures a prohibited term. In a covered Connecticut transaction, no right to notice, judicial hearing, or prior court order for a prejudgment remedy is waived. In a covered Virginia transaction, actions shall be brought in Virginia as required by Section 7.5. In a covered Texas transaction, this Agreement contains no confession of judgment or similar provision; the parties acknowledge that Texas Finance Code Section 398.055 makes a contract containing such a provision void and unenforceable, and Section 7.7 does not alter that result. For a transaction subject to California Financial Code Section 22806, after Buyer extends a specific offer and during the application process, whenever Buyer states a charge, pricing metric, or financing amount for that offer, Buyer shall also state the offer’s annual percentage rate using “annual percentage rate” or “APR.” No deposit-account debit is authorized by this Agreement. Any mandatory protection more favorable to Merchant controls.
TEXAS TRANSACTIONS — OCCC NOTICE
The Office of Consumer Credit Commissioner (OCCC) is a state agency that enforces certain laws that apply to this contract. If a complaint cannot be resolved by contacting the provider, a commercial sales-based financing recipient can contact the OCCC to file a complaint. OCCC address: 2601 N. Lamar Blvd., Austin, Texas 78705. Phone: (800) 538-1579. Website: occc.texas.gov.
current_body: To the extent any provision of this Agreement is prohibited or rendered unenforceable by the law of the state in which Merchant is located, including Conn. Gen. Stat. §36a-868 (which bars a waiver of a recipient’s right to notice, judicial hearing or prior court order in connection with a prejudgment remedy) and Tex. Fin. Code §398.055 (which voids confession-of-judgment and similar provisions), that provision does not apply to this Agreement and the remainder of the Agreement continues in effect. Nothing in Section 7.12 or Section 10 waives any right to notice, to a judicial hearing, or to a prior court order that the law of Merchant’s state makes non-waivable.
my_note: This clause is the deployment surface for all eleven states and it currently misstates Texas, ignores Virginia venue, and relies on severing provisions a covered contract may not contain. Insert the exact OCCC notice for Texas transactions — a separate disclosure does not satisfy an in-contract notice requirement.

memo_rationale: The all-documents/forms/interviews “complete in all respects” certification sweeps in third-party summaries and innocent errors. Calling any misrepresentation fraud does not establish scienter, reliance, causation, or damages. Limit the certification to identified material submissions and preserve separate capacities.
memo_replacement: The parties execute this Agreement as of their stated signature dates. A Merchant signatory signs solely in the identified authorized business capacity unless separately signing as Guarantor under Section 9. Merchant confirms that its identified written factual submissions, to its knowledge after reasonable inquiry, are materially accurate as of their stated dates, subject to disclosed qualifications and corrections. No person adopts an unidentified document or an inaccurate recording summary by this signature. Liability for fraud or intentional misrepresentation requires proof of the elements imposed by applicable law and is not established merely by an error or omission. Each signer shall receive the complete signed documents and applicable disclosures.
current_body: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date. Each of Merchant and Guarantor represents that he or she is authorized to sign this Agreement, legally binding Merchant and Guarantor to comply with the terms of this Agreement and that the information provided herein and in all of Buyer’s documents, forms, and recorded interviews is true, accurate, and complete in all respects. Any misrepresentation made by Merchant or Guarantor in connection with this Agreement may constitute a separate cause of action for fraud or intentional misrepresentation.
my_note: A 'complete in all respects' certification over all documents, forms and interviews sweeps in third-party summaries and innocent errors, and labelling any misstatement 'fraud' does not supply scienter or causation. Limit to identified material submissions.

memo_rationale: The actual authorization is not supplied. This reference cannot be cleared without the processor/acquirer’s enforceable agreement and a verified settlement flow. A UCC notice of a partial-payment assignment may not compel the processor to split payments at all. The text below replaces only the reference clause, not the missing authorization. [A7]
memo_replacement: Before funding, Merchant and Buyer shall execute a separate Split Funding Authorization for each Approved Processor and obtain the processor’s written acceptance of the arrangement. The authorization shall match Sections 1, 2, 3, and 6, identify the exact Card Receipts base, Specified Percentage, single aggregate Purchased Amount cap across all processors, coordinated processor-level limits, start date, correction and refund mechanics, and stop procedure, and prohibit fixed minimums, default percentage increases, deposit-account debits, and collection of unrelated fees. It shall identify processor reserves, chargebacks, prior rights, and settlement timing. No authorization expands the purchase, Guaranty, or remedies. The complete executed authorization and processor acceptance shall be attached to the transaction record and delivered to Merchant; no missing form is incorporated by this reference alone.
current_body: A separate Split Funding Authorization Letter shall be executed for each Approved Processor identified in Section 1.5, instructing the Approved Processor to remit the Specified Percentage of credit and debit card receipts directly to Buyer’s designated account. The form of the Split Funding Authorization is attached and incorporated by reference, and shall be executed contemporaneously with this Agreement.
my_note: Critical hold, and I would go further than the memo: this is the question that determines whether the product works at all. A UCC §9-406 notice of a PARTIAL assignment does not compel an acquirer to split settlement. Nothing else in this agreement matters if Payzli will not honour the split. Get a countersigned processor acceptance and test a real settlement including tax, tips, refunds and reserves.
